title: Regulatory Deferral Accounts
summary: An optional, first-time-adopter-only standard permitting continuation of previous GAAP regulatory deferral account balances, converged with IFRS 14 but of notably limited practical applicability in India.

bannerNotice.title: Important Indian modifications – limited applicability
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 114 is an optional standard of limited practical relevance in India. Indian regulated entities generally follow CERC/SERC tariff regulations separately, and previous Indian GAAP did not customarily recognise regulatory deferral account balances as assets/liabilities in the way IFRS 14 contemplates.
